_comment: Burn-down list for surrogate-safe-truncate.ts (2026-08-17 poison-record class).
May only SHRINK: a stale entry (one that no longer violates) fails the rule.
Migrate a site to truncateUtf16Safe, then DELETE its key here.
- anchor-bulk / cle-verify: fingerprint hex slices — ASCII, cannot split a pair. Safe forever; kept here rather than a code allow-list so the census stays in one file.
- demo-event-injector / proof-packet: JSON.stringify of small fixed objects, far under the 10000 cap — slice is a no-op today. If the object grows, migrate.
- ruleEventBackpressure: JSON.stringify(details).slice(0, 10000) into audit details — poisonable if details carry astral text near the cap; ALSO truncates JSON syntax. Follow-up burn-down.
- webhooks/{adobe-sign,checkr,docusign} webhook_dlq.reason: failure bookkeeping bounded from provider-influenced text — same class as job_queue.last_error. Follow-up burn-down.
- bq-export-watermark last_run_error / workspace-subscription-renewal last_renewal_error: error-message bookkeeping. Follow-up burn-down.

- openalexFetcher abstract slice(0, 2000): external scholarly text into public_records metadata — the ORIGINAL incident's feeder shape. Follow-up burn-down (jobs/ fetchers were out of this PR's scope; publicRecordAnchor.ts itself is owned by PR #2266).
